name: Jadesserts
tagline: A little box of sweet surprises

shape.motif: heart bullets + pastel confetti (circles, sparkles, hearts); a 4-segment pastel bar that stands for the 4 items in the box

do: Warm cream is the default background; stage colours are pastels (pink, lavender, mint, peach)
Use heart glyphs as the list bullet and confetti shapes for texture
Everything rounded; soft, bouncy motion (overshoot) rather than mechanical
Price is its own oversized callout
dont: No stark white or grey backgrounds, no black shadows (tint shadows plum/pink)
Never put white small text on the coral primary (3.1:1) — display sizes only
No more than one saturated coral block per scene

_notes.fonts: Baloo 2 + Quicksand are the design system's flagged substitutes for the real bubble wordmark font. If they cannot load (offline/proxy), the fallback stack renders instead; supply woff2/ttf via type.fontFiles to render exactly.
_notes.extraRoles: blush, blushDeep, primaryDeep, mint, lavender, white are Jadesserts-specific extras used for the sweet box, outlines and hearts.
_notes.toyRoles: toyYellow, bone, wood, cardboard, glass are toy-world roles used by kits/brickworld.mjs (brick-people skin, skeleton, props, signs, windows).
